pages.text: $(l)Keep passives supplied$()$(li)Use large buffers for passive machines (e.g., Wrath Rune, Hungering Casings) to avoid starvation when intermediate items are consumed before the next crafting step.
$(li)Run a Vibrating Flux Crucible constantly with a timed Mechanical User and Flux Sponge to maintain stable flux supply.

$(l)Rune and packaging automation$()$(li)For Wrath/Gluttony runes: use an item collector filtered $(o)only$() for completed runes (not components), store them internally, and trigger rune output via SFM + interface checks for wish dust and mana diamonds.
$(li)For packaging: use a 9× setup of torch-powered packaging providers—higher multipliers do not increase throughput.

$(l)Common pitfalls$()$(li)Do not use RF Tools Crafters’ filtering—place interface, drawer, and machine directly, then red-print the recipe.$(li)If you use Arsenic, don't source it from a single ancient rock crusher with six upgrades; that bottlenecks supply.

$(li)Ensure Borax transposers have enderium upgrades; base transposers make filling extremely slow.$(li)If your Teleposer gets stuck: place the block at target, insert the item, and apply redstone—swap items or reposition if needed.
